contract: Feed complete NAL units from RawAnnexBReader through Decoder::send_nal. The H.264 split schedule sends Annex B bytes through Decoder::send_nals in chunks of one to 4096 bytes from a seeded generator. Chunks may end inside a start code, NAL payload or access unit.

Supply the access unit ordinal as PTS once, on the first NAL or first chunk. Compare with the reference's parser-driven decode using the same timestamp rule per access unit. Flush both decoders after the last input.

Fold kind 1 with visible geometry, depth, plane count, optional signed PTS, and the per-plane MD5s in decoder output order. The six nal-workloads rows use the codec workload RGBA fold and native reference worker.
